title: The defining projection comparison with ordinary proper comparison
statement: For finite commutative A, f:X -> S proper, an isomorphism i:X isomorphic to P=ProjectiveLine(S) over S, either projection a, and any ordinary derived coefficient object K on the self-product of P, the component at K of projectionComparison from [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data] equals ordinaryProperForgetComparison for the a-projection at the pullback of K along the self-product map, followed by the inverse proper projection exchange component at K. The proper comparison is the canonical forget-supports isomorphism itself, with the ordinary derived direct image endpoint recorded.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M, the diagonal is a section for either projection, and substitution of canonical pullback counits before applying direct image.

proof.text: First prove the whole defining-isomorphism equality by unfolding projectionComparison. Apply congrArg to evaluate its hom at K. The general categorical formula for the component of a whiskered composite, proved privately before specialization, identifies this with the canonical proper forget-supports component followed by inverse exchange. This avoids rechecking concrete derived-functor definitions in component reduction.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionComparison_eq_ordinaryProperForget
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f) (a : Bool)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A
      (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))) :
    (projectionComparison A f i hi a).hom.app K =
      (ordinaryProperForgetComparison A (projection f a)).hom.app
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (productMap f i hi)).obj K) ≫
        (properExchange A (projectionSquare f i hi a)).inv.app K
